title: Epsilon-Sigma Endo-Parameters
body_html:
Epsilon-Sigma Endo-Parameters

An $(\varepsilon,\sigma)$-endo-parameter over $F$ is a $\sigma$-invariant finitely supported section of

$$ \bigsqcup_{\mathfrak c\in\mathscr E(F)} \operatorname{herm}_{\varepsilon}(\mathfrak c) \longrightarrow \mathscr E(F). $$

The set of such parameters is denoted

$$ \mathscr{EP}_{\varepsilon}(F)^\sigma. $$

There is a forgetful map

$$ \mathscr{EP}_{\varepsilon}(F)^\sigma \to \mathscr{EP}(F)^\sigma. $$

The totally positive subset

$$ \mathscr{EP}_{\varepsilon}^+(F)^\sigma $$

consists of parameters supported away from the trivial endo-class.

Draft Caution

This is only the lightweight draft-level formulation needed by the current paper. The precise KSS definition should be extracted from the registered KSS PDF source later.
